newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound strengthens slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound strengthens slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound strengthened slightly against the dollar on Thursday in a private sector market with a lot of the U.S. currency on offer, bankers said.
"The market is still liquid," a banker said. The market had been dollar short for several weeks before the end of the government's financial year on June 30.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3880 and 3.3895 bid and at between 3.3900 and 3.3910 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Thursday was 3.38875 pounds bid and 3.390625 pounds offered in the interbank market. These averages compare to 3.389375 bid and 3.39175 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.387860 pounds buy and 3.392279 pounds sell.
